title: Reserve stock in batches at checkout
body: Reserves stock through the inventory service in batches instead of one request per SKU. Batch size is configurable per store.

commit.messageHeadline: Return early when no SKUs to reserve
Make reservation batch size configurable per store

nodes.body:
_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🔴 Critical_

**`batchSize` of 0 hangs the reservation loop.**

`??` only falls back for `null`/`undefined`, so a store with `reservationBatchSize: 0` passes `0` through. `start += 0` never advances and the `while` loop keeps posting empty reservations forever. A negative value has the same problem. Clamp it to at least 1 (or reject non-positive values).

```diff
-  const batchSize = opts.batchSize ?? 50;
+  const batchSize = Math.max(1, opts.batchSize ?? 50);
```
